## Highlights
### Improved
- On iPad and an unfolded iPhone, the page now slides with the sidebar as you switch Spaces, instead of changing all at once when the switch ends. With Reduce Motion on, the page stays still. - With “Animate pages when switching Spaces” off or Reduce Motion on, the page now fades into the next Space's as you switch, following your swipe and the sidebar, instead of jumping when the switch ends, on Mac, iPad and an unfolded iPhone. iPhone and iPad now have the setting in Appearance too.
### Fixed
- Chromium is updated to 157.0.8103.80, with 83 upstream security fixes, five of them critical.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
